stage.name: Industrial Depths
stage.description:
Not even an all-consuming abyss can stop Duck Lord from making a quick buck.

<Orientation Trial> Use a pre-picked squad of 3 Operators.

elite_brawler.name: Elite Brawler
elite_brawler.flavourText: Exceptionally dangerous combatants who are even more destructive than normal Brawlers. Only the most heavily-armored Operators can withstand their blows.

sponsor_drone.name: Sponsor Drone
sponsor_drone.flavourText: Ellen Select Technology thanks you for your sponsorship! This quick and affordable drone carries the passion of the fans, bringing anything to the knights on the field: traps, explosives, medicine, or even snacks! The outcome of the battle is in your hands!
abilities: Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
When destroyed, grants a deployable unit

bone_sea_drifter.name: Bone Sea Drifter
bone_sea_drifter.flavourText: Sea Terrors travel in large swarms, seeking carcasses to feast on and becoming food for other Sea Terrors themselves.

infantry_leader.name: Infantry Leader
infantry_leader.flavourText: A basic melee soldier. They are stronger than normal Infantry.

ocean_stonecutter.name: Ocean Stonecutter
ocean_stonecutter.flavourText: Sea Terror with a hard shell, protecting the swarm from enemies.
abilities: When your units enter its attack range for the first time, temporarily stops moving and gains increased DEF.

sniper_leader.name: Sniper Leader
sniper_leader.flavourText: A basic ranged soldier. They are stronger than normal Snipers, firing improved ammunition that stuns for a longer duration. Proceed with caution.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack Stuns its target

fully_enclosed_beach_buggy.name: Fully-Enclosed Beach Buggy
fully_enclosed_beach_buggy.flavourText: A beach buggy beloved by all. Carries three passengers in addition to the driver. Cool and breezy on the inside, it's perfect for those tuckered out from playing.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When next to enemies that are both non-Machine and non-Leader, they will be loaded inside as passengers (up to 3 max), and will be unloaded when this unit is defeated

famiglia_luxury_limo.name: Famiglia Luxury Limo
famiglia_luxury_limo.flavourText: A lesser-seen vehicle among the famiglie, sporting an unassuming exterior but a luxurious interior. Generally, these are only used to welcome the most distinguished of the famiglia's guests, and to convey to them the graces of the famiglia's high-ranking members.
abilities: Unloads 3 <Elite Famiglia Soldiers> if this is unit is defeated while blocked

mudrock_colossus.name: Mudrock Colossus
mudrock_colossus.flavourText: This Originium construct, crafted by Mudrock, does not possess sentience and must be directly controlled by Mudrock. Though bulky and slow, they are extremely durable and boast terrifying physical damage and survivability.

retching_broodmother.name: Retching Broodmother
retching_broodmother.flavourText: Sea Terror mothers that throw fake offspring at oncoming threats, allowing the true offspring to flee.
abilities: Summons 1 <Baleful Broodling> near the target when dealing damage

crying_thief.name: Crying Thief
crying_thief.flavourText: A Perro who left his family to seek out a new life... but all that people know is that he is always weeping.

duck_lord.name: Duck Lord
duck_lord.flavourText: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abilities: Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

gopnik.name: Gopnik
gopnik.flavourText: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

fatty.name: Fatty
fatty.flavourText: Duck Lord's associate and apprentice, an opportunist with a slick tongue. Frequently appears on dubious TV shows, preaching about how he cares little for losses or gains, as they are part of the natural money-making process.
abilities: Always faces the direction with the most Operators.
Takes 80% less Physical/Arts damage from the front.

chest_seaborn.name: Chest Seaborn
chest_seaborn.flavourText: Sea Terror disguised as a treasure chest, often used by Bishops of the Deep to protect hideouts.
